name: Air Radiator
full_description: ViEX describes the air radiator, also called an air heater, as heat exchange equipment used for air heating in hot air drying devices. The official page states that steam or hot water flows through the steel tube while heat is transferred to the air passing through the fins outside the tightly wound or rolled steel pipe, providing high-speed heat transfer surface, vibration resistance, corrosion resistance, and long service life.
advantage: Designed for air heating in hot air drying devices

technical_parameters.Structure: Tight or rolled finned steel tube
technical_parameters.Application: Air heating in hot air drying devices

details.title: What is the main use case?
details.content: The official page presents the product as an air heating heat exchanger for hot air drying devices.

details.title: What performance characteristics are emphasized?
details.content: ViEX emphasizes high-speed heat transfer surface, strong vibration resistance, corrosion resistance, and long service life.

seo_data.meta_description: Air radiator and air heater for hot air drying devices with finned steel tube heat transfer design.
